description: Figure 6(a), located on the left side of the page, is a bar chart illustrating the distribution of datasets over time, categorized by the five most frequent researcher locations and all other locations combined. The horizontal axis represents the year, ranging from 2012 to 2022, while the vertical axis, labeled “Number of datasets,” uses a logarithmic scale ranging from 10⁰ (1) to 10² (100). Although the chart’s visual content is obscured by a gray placeholder, the caption indicates that researchers from the U.S. consistently publish the most datasets over time, while researchers from other countries began producing more datasets starting in 2016. The chart is intended to show temporal trends in dataset production by geographic origin, with the U.S. as the dominant contributor and a noticeable increase in output from other countries after 2016.
